unit_of_work: One rule clause paired with one code unit. An interaction is a code unit with explicit participant spans.

prompts.compile: Extract independently checkable clauses from the supplied rule. Preserve its force, conditions, exceptions and source wording. Return the assigned JSON schema; report ambiguity.
prompts.screen: Screen this one rule against this one unit. Return a candidate, no signal, a typed context request, or unresolved. Cite supplied evidence IDs.
prompts.confirm: Test the candidate against the rule, its conditions, exceptions and counterevidence. Return one evidence-backed disposition or a typed context request.
prompts.fix: Resolve the authorized finding within the supplied scope and preserve the listed behavior. Use the provided edit tools, then return the patch artifact and proposed validation; report any required decision.
prompts.recheck: Independently evaluate the original finding and affected behavior on the patched tree. Use current evidence and return the assigned schema.

routing: Freeze the Git revision, working-tree content and governing instruction scope. Parse guide sections deterministically; compile changed sections only, preserving source spans.

Create the declared unit inventory and a rule-by-unit coverage matrix. Use conservative, deterministic applicability selectors; record exclusions with reasons. Uncertain applicability enters screening.
Run existing deterministic checks directly where they decide the obligation. Store tool evidence; use confirmation for interpretation that remains semantic.

Run up to eight independent Luna-low screens concurrently, one call per pair. Candidate and needs_context enter up to two Sol-high confirmation tasks immediately; no_signal is recorded and a stratified sample also goes to confirmation.

Confirmation, repair and recheck may request typed context. Code resolves allowlisted lookups, records hashes and resumes the same task. Screening needs_context advances to confirmation. Missing evidence and exhausted budgets remain unresolved.

Confirmation returns confirmed_violation, design_suggestion, refuted or unresolved. Require an actual trigger, observable mismatch, source evidence, applicability analysis and exception analysis for a violation.
Only confirmed, authorized findings enter the fix queue. Suggestions and important choices require a decision under governing instructions. Existing authorization is retained.
Deduplicate confirmed findings while retaining supporting task IDs. Permit one repair lifecycle per repository, from leased edits through independent recheck and completed validation.
Acquire a worktree lease before edits. The high-capability model handles one confirmed finding with bounded related edits. Code captures the diff and verifies its base and scope.

Run minimal local checks, publish a draft PR, then finish required validation and independent rule/behavior recheck. Failures return structured feedback to the fixer; bounded exhaustion remains blocked.
Mark ready and release the lease only after required validation passes. Record local and platform results separately. Invalidate affected units and context dependents and rescan.

Resume by task keys and stage artifacts. Reuse only matching rule, code, context, instruction, prompt, schema and model-config hashes. Use periodic full inventory passes to catch missed dependency invalidation.
harness_checks: Validate the selected JSON schema; reject extra fields, wrong stage/task IDs and invalid enum variants.
Verify every source span and quote against the frozen content, including line ordering. Bind evidence IDs and patch artifacts to actual harness-produced artifacts.
Reject confirmed_violation for a preference unless an independently identified obligation supports it. Preserve justified tradeoffs and exceptions.
Route by validated status and governing policy; model confidence is not an authorization or routing threshold.
Grant tools by stage: compiler read-only source, screen supplied JSON only, confirm read-only context and isolated checks, fix leased edits, recheck read-only current evidence.
Run validation from the repository check catalog. Model-suggested check targets are proposals; model text cannot claim a command actually ran.
Validation passes only with the required checks passed on the final tree and the independent recheck resolved. Record skipped or blocked checks explicitly.
Bound context, retries and cost in harness policy; exhaustion cannot become clean or compliant. Material new settings follow the repository approval process.
Model and effort come from the controller execution profile. Record actual invocation metadata; schema-valid model text cannot change its own model, reasoning effort, parallelism or tool rights.

coverage_and_calibration.reporting: Screened coverage and deeply verified coverage are reported separately, relative to the declared unit inventory and rule scope.
coverage_and_calibration.calibration: Treat the explicit model and effort settings as pilot hypotheses. Compare them on labeled violations and clean counterexamples before promoting the profile; measure screening recall, confirmation precision, fix correctness, cost and latency.
coverage_and_calibration.sampling: Stratify no-signal audits by rule and unit kind. Report sample size and missed findings; expand affected strata after misses. Sampling estimates miss rate and never proves full compliance.
coverage_and_calibration.architectural_scope: Ownership, lifetime and deployment rules require explicit interaction units and context traces. Incomplete inventory or traces remain coverage gaps.

skills: The recurring model calls use fixed stage prompts and typed data. Repository-specific lease and publication procedures are invoked once at the change boundary, outside review prompts.
authorization: This artifact proposes a design. It does not authorize scanning, code changes, jobs, configuration changes or publication.
